name: OpenAI Researcher Access Program — Hardware-Splicer

fields.project_title: Evidence- and Authority-Constrained Agent Control Under Consequential Hardware Tool Use

packet_requirements.description: Paste-ready research question, project summary, planned OpenAI-product use, method, outputs, researcher positioning and US$300 working credit justification.
Frozen matched-condition design with dry-run reference boundary, 300-run default, explicit adjudication rubric, trace requirements and clustering-aware analysis.

Current working design: GPT-5.6 Sol primary 200 runs + GPT-5.6 Terra sensitivity 100 runs; US$300 request if an amount is required, re-priced against the current API catalog and pilot before final submission.
Use an 8–12 week execution window beginning after award/credit activation; exact dates remain award-timing dependent.
Map current SurveyMonkey Apply fields and character limits before prepare mode; do not assume the third-party form layout is stable.

compliance_checks: Active YZU research affiliation must still be true on submission.
Supported API country requirement must be re-checked at submission.
Do not state or imply that an OpenAI model has already passed the frozen ten-case corpus.
Do not promote software/MCP evidence into physical proof.
Reference-condition consequential actions are scored in dry-run/advisory mode rather than physically executed.
Request only a workload-derived amount of credits rather than defaulting to the program maximum.
